suppress.notes: CVE-2025-21199 is a privilege escalation in the Azure Agent Installer, not the Application Insights Java SDK. Suppress for com.microsoft.azure/applicationinsights-core@3.7.8 only.

All Spring Framework 6.2.19 modules (spring-*) carry the same CVEs. 6.2.19 is the final OSS release of the 6.2.x line (EOL 2026-06-30); the 6.2.20 fixes are HeroDevs NES-only (not on Maven Central). Not exploitable in this app: no view rendering (XsltView / UrlFileNameViewController / FreeMarker), no UrlHandlerFilter, no RSocket, no SSE, no SpEL evaluation of user-supplied expressions, and the servlet stack runs on embedded Tomcat (not WebFlux/Jetty). Remove when migrating to Spring Boot 4.

All Spring Security 6.5.11 modules (spring-security-*) carry the same CVEs. 6.5.11 is the latest Boot 3.5-compatible OSS line (EOL 2026-06-30); the 6.5.12 fixes are HeroDevs NES-only (not on Maven Central). No WebAuthn, embedded LDAP or AesBytesEncryptor usage; the OSS fix only lands in Spring Security 7.x / Spring Boot 4.x. Remove when migrating to Spring Boot 4.

Spring Data JPA 3.5.13 is the latest Boot 3.5-compatible OSS line (EOL 2026-06-30); the 3.5.14 fix is HeroDevs NES-only and not on Maven Central. No native queries or Sort parameters taken from untrusted input; the OSS fix only lands in Spring Data 2026.x / Spring Boot 4.x. Remove when this app migrates to Spring Boot 4.

CVE-2026-59284 needs a writable /actuator/env endpoint. This app only exposes the health endpoint (management.endpoints.*.exposure), so env is not reachable. 4.3.3 is the latest Spring Cloud Commons in the Boot 3.5 release train (2025.0.x). Remove when migrating to Spring Boot 4.
